newsitem.title: USA: Economists see Fed add, but no move also possible.
newsitem.headline: Economists see Fed add, but no move also possible.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was seen as having a small add need it may address by executing overnight or fixed-term multiple day repurchase agreements on Thursday. It also may opt to stay out of the market, economists said.

"With a $6.74 billion 14-day fixed-term RP already in place for the first week of the (new) settlement period, and the settlement of the fifth tranche of the coupon pass adding another $1.42 billion, it would be possible for the Fed to remain on the sidelines today if the add need is to the low side of our projections. More likely, however, the Fed will arrange a modest (less than $3 billion) four-day fixed-term RP to get it through the weekend," said Marc Wanshel, economist at Morgan Guaranty Trust Co.
Fed funds were trading at 5.19 percent, slightly below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663 ))
